_note: Sample data with verified working URLs to the most relevant section of each agency's site. Once the GitHub Action runs, this is replaced with live RSS data where every link is the actual article URL.

items.title: Cybersecurity in Medical Devices: Quality System Considerations and Content of Premarket Submissions
items.summary: FDA finalizes guidance establishing Secure Product Development Framework requirements and SBOM expectations for premarket submissions.

items.title: Class I Recall: Infusion Pump Firmware Defect May Cause Overdelivery
items.summary: Manufacturer initiates voluntary correction following 14 reported events including 2 deaths. Firmware patch staged for global deployment.

items.title: MDCG 2026-3: Updated Borderline & Classification Manual
items.summary: New chapters on AI-driven clinical decision support, digital therapeutics, and substances administered via medical devices. Reclassifications affect Annex VIII Rule 11 software products.

items.title: Federal Register: Proposed Rule on Reusable Device Reprocessing Validation Standards
items.summary: CDRH-led NPRM tightening reprocessing validation expectations for reusable surgical instruments. 60-day comment period.

items.title: PMDA Notification: UDI Implementation Phase 3
items.summary: Phase 3 of Japan's Unique Device Identification rollout now covers Class II non-implantable devices. Manufacturers and authorized representatives must update GS1 registrations by 1 October 2026.

items.title: UK Medical Devices Post-market Surveillance Regulations 2025 Now in Force
items.summary: PSURs, periodic safety updates, and serious incident reporting timelines have been formally aligned with EU MDR Article 87.

items.title: Health Canada Recall: Surgical Mesh — Sterile Barrier Failure
items.summary: Three lots affected. Distributor-level correction underway. No patient harm reported to date.

items.title: Health Canada Consultation: Medical Device Establishment Licence Modernization
items.summary: Consultation opens on a streamlined MDEL framework with risk-based inspection tiers harmonised with FDA Establishment Registration.

items.title: TGA Consultation: Reclassification of Spinal Implantable Devices
items.summary: Australia proposes aligning with EU classification approach for spinal implants, moving most products to Class III. 90-day comment period.

items.title: FDA 510(k) Clearances: 17 De Novo Grants and 312 510(k) Clearances Posted
items.summary: Notable: first AI-enabled cardiac MRI quantification tool with autonomous-mode labeling; novel bioresorbable scaffold for peripheral vasculature.

items.title: Draft Guidance: Real-World Data for Premarket Decisions
items.summary: CDRH proposes expanded acceptance criteria for real-world evidence in 510(k) and De Novo submissions. 60-day comment window.

items.title: FDA Class I Recall: Implantable Defibrillator Lead — Fracture Risk
items.summary: Prospective surveillance flags above-expected fracture rate in subset of leads manufactured between 2023–2024. Physicians advised to monitor patients.

items.title: PMA Approval: Multi-Target Liquid Biopsy Companion Diagnostic
items.summary: First PMA approval for multi-target liquid biopsy companion diagnostic across solid tumors. Class III clearance with post-approval study commitments.

items.title: MDCG 2026-2: Clinical Evaluation Equivalence Pathways
items.summary: Updated criteria for technical, biological, and clinical equivalence demonstrations under Article 61. References to third-country market data permitted under defined conditions.

items.title: New Notified Body Designation Under MDR — TÜV SÜD Czech
items.summary: NANDO database adds another MDR-designated NB. Now 56 active notified bodies for MDR; 12 for IVDR.

items.title: EUDAMED Module 6 (Vigilance) Mandatory Activation Notice
items.summary: Vigilance and post-market module switches from voluntary to mandatory use on 11 May. All MIRs, FSCAs, and PSURs to be filed via EUDAMED from that date.

items.title: Draft Guidance: Predetermined Change Control Plans for AI/ML Devices
items.summary: Companion document to the AI/ML PCCP final rule. Walks through example PCCPs, expected modification protocols, and impact assessments. Comments due in 90 days.

items.title: PMDA Updates Marketing Authorization Holder Requirements
items.summary: Revised MAH responsibilities for Class III/IV devices, with new emphasis on local clinical liaison and post-launch surveillance reporting cadence.

items.title: FDA eMDR Submission System — Schema Update for Software Malfunction Reporting
items.summary: New required fields for software-related malfunction reporting. Manufacturers should update gateway integrations before 1 May.

items.title: MHRA Consultation: Future UK Regulatory Regime — Core Statutory Instrument
items.summary: Foundational consultation for UK's post-Brexit medical device framework. Covers classification, conformity assessment routes, UKCA marking timeline. Closes 28 June.

items.title: TGA Adverse Event Reporting Timeline Reminder
items.summary: Reminder of statutory reporting clocks: 2-day, 10-day, and 30-day pathways depending on event severity. Trend reporting now required for systematic issues.

items.title: Health Canada Vigilance Reporting Annual Summary 2025
items.summary: Aggregate report of medical device incidents reported in 2025. Notable upticks in software-related events; flat trend in implantable failures.
items.source: Health Canada — Medical Device Problem Reporting

items.title: MDCG Q&A on Trend Reporting Under Article 88
items.summary: Clarifies what constitutes a 'statistically significant increase' and provides example calculations. Manufacturers should update PMS procedures.

items.title: Federal Register: AI/ML PCCP Lifecycle Management — Final Rule
items.summary: Codifies predetermined change control plans for algorithm-driven devices. Effective 180 days after publication.
